versions.changelog:
Initial release of loot-reward-celebrator skill.

- Provides a structured way to celebrate completed tasks and milestones using a loot table and fair reward planning.
- Guides users to select sustainable, healthy, and value-aligned rewards.
- Helps make wins visible and meaningful without encouraging unhealthy or costly behaviors.
- Suggests next unlock conditions to motivate continued progress.
- Delivers outputs in markdown, including loot tables, reward suggestions, visible records, and sustainability guardrails.
